title: Ekirangiriro ky'okubbira mu mazzi
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’omufuzi ow’amaanyi eyeetooloddwa ekitiibwa, ebijjukizo, n’amagye agagondera ekiragiro kimu. Omuntu ono yeeyita nti ye yalina obuyinza obw’oku ntikko, n’agoba obubonero obw’obwakatonda ng’obulimba, era n’alagira okuyigga obutasalako nga boolekedde ennyanja. Goberera ekkubo okuva ku biragiro by’amalala okutuuka ku mazzi agaawuddwamu, ng’okwatula okusembayo kutuuka kikeerezi nnyo okutaasa.
clues: Nakwata obuyinza obujjuvu era ne nfuula Abaana ba Isirayiri abaddu wansi w’obufuzi bwange.
Nalangirira nti ndi mukama asinga waggulu era ne ηηaana okukkiriza katonda yenna asinga nze.
Nalagira Kamani okunzimbira omunaala omugulumivu nsobole okutunuulira Katonda wa Musa.
Nayolekagana ne Musa ne Harun bwe baaleeta obubonero obw’olwatu, era ebyamagero byabwe ne mbiyita obulogo.
Nagoberera Musa n’abakkiriza n’amagye gange ekiro okutuusa lwe twatuuka ku nnyanja.
Nalangirira okukkiriza nga nbbira mu nnyanja, naye obudde bwali buyise nnyo, era omubiri gwange ne gukuumibwa ng’akabonero.

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Yasuulibwa mu muliro ogwafuuka omunnyogovu era nga tegulina bulabe
Yazimba eryato okusobola okuwona amataba amangi
Yasula mu mpuku ne banne okumala emyaka mingi
Yabbira mu mazzi ng’agoba Musa n’Abaisiraeri nga bayita mu nnyanja eyawuddwamu
trial.answer: Yabbira mu mazzi ng’agoba Musa n’Abaisiraeri nga bayita mu nnyanja eyawuddwamu

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yazuukizibwa nga mulamu okutuuka mu ggulu
Yasonyiyibwa era n’aweebwa obufuzi obw’emirembe obuwanvu
Yabbira mu butakkiriza era omubiri ne gukuumibwa ng’akabonero eri abo oluvannyuma
outcome.answer: Yabbira mu butakkiriza era omubiri ne gukuumibwa ng’akabonero eri abo oluvannyuma

arabic: ءَآلْـَٔـٰنَ وَقَدْ عَصَيْتَ قَبْلُ وَكُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verse: Now? And you had disobeyed [Him] before and were of the corrupters? (10:91)
